paragraphs: From Athlone Test Centre on Castlemaine Street move off and continue a short distance to the roundabout.
At the roundabout take the slight left exit to stay on Castlemaine Street.
Take the 1st right onto Lower Road.
Follow Lower Road as it becomes Retreat Road and continue straight for around 800 metres.
At the next roundabout take the 1st exit onto Cartrontroy Road and continue for over a kilometre.
At the rotary take the exit for Garrycastle Road.
At the following roundabout continue onto Bushfield Road.
Follow the signs onto the on ramp and merge slight right onto the Athlone Bypass.
Stay on the bypass and then take the off ramp on the left.
Turn left onto Ballymahon Road.
At the roundabout take the 1st exit to stay on Ballymahon Road and continue for around 700 metres.
Turn left onto Sean Costello Street then take the next right onto Castlemaine Street.
At the roundabout take the slight left exit to stay on Castlemaine Street.
Continue a short distance then turn left onto Sean Costello Street and take the next left.
At the next roundabout turn left onto MacDiarmada Road.
At the following roundabout take the slight left exit onto Castlemaine Street.
Continue for nearly a kilometre then turn left onto Killyon Hill.
At the roundabout take the 1st exit onto Cartrontroy Road.
Turn right into Hillcourt and follow the examiner's instructions for a turnabout in this quiet estate.
Exit Hillcourt and turn right onto Cartrontroy Road.
Continue to the rotary and take the exit for University Road.
Turn left to stay on University Road then complete a U-turn on the unnamed side road as directed.
Return to University Road and turn left.
At the roundabout take the 1st exit onto Wash House Turn.
At the next roundabout take the 1st exit onto Dublin Road and follow it for around 1.5 kilometres.
Approaching the test centre area take the roundabout slight left to stay on Castlemaine Street.
Turn right onto Lower Road and continue straight as it becomes Retreat Road.
Take the next left onto Retreat Avenue then another left to stay on Retreat Avenue.
Turn left onto the Old Rail Trail to finish the route back near Athlone Test Centre.
